segments.sn55.44:1.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako ‘aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo’ti [mahābhogo mahāyasoti (syā. pī. ka.)] vuccati.
segments.sn55.44:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti –
segments.sn55.44:2.3: itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti;
segments.sn55.44:2.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi … pe … samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
segments.sn55.44:2.7: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako ‘aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo’ti vuccatī”ti.

lines: Catutthe aḍḍho mahaddhanoti sattavidhena ariyadhanena aḍḍho ceva mahaddhano ca.
Ariyānaṃ buddhānaṃ dhanantipi ariyadhanaṃ, nibbānanti keci.
Anayatopi visuddhaṭṭhena ariyañca taṃ dhanañca dhanāyitaṭṭhenāti ariyadhanaṃ, tena ariyadhanena.
